    FAQs

    Quick answers before you register.

    Who can participate?

    Open only to second-year students of B.Tech, Diploma, BCA and MCA. Inter-college teams are welcome.

    What is the team size?

    Teams can have 1 to 5 members. Every member enters their name and college ID when registering.

    Is there a registration fee?

    Registration for HackKDK 2026 is completely free. There is no fee to join, and meals, Wi-Fi, mentorship and swag are all provided at no cost to you.

    What should I bring?

    Your college ID, laptop, chargers and your best ideas.

    Can I start building before the event?

    No pre-written code. Brainstorming, mockups and exploring libraries are fine; coding starts when hacking kicks off.
